claims.claim: It is a motor speed reducer

No test, bench run, or electrical output is shown in the photos.
No audio or running video is provided to confirm the absence of knocking.
No odometer, service record, or usage history is shown; alternator mileage is not visible in the photos.
No close-up of seals, screws, or housing condition is shown to confirm it was never opened.
